alerts.title: Purchaser-exclusion edit force-paused the account's only active campaign (Mori_Sales_0609), launched by a human hours earlier
alerts.detail: A new campaign Mori_Sales_0609 (id 120255648636980159, OUTCOME_SALES, daily_budget Rs.1,000) with ad set 'Kabuto_CAPS' (id 120255648636990159) and ad 'Mori_Sales' (id 120255648637000159) was created and set ACTIVE by a human at 2026-09-06T09:19:44+05:30 (per account activity log: Campaign created / Ad set created / Ad set status updated in the last ~100 events), with no excluded_custom_audiences on its targeting. This routine's purchaser-exclusion module (auto tier, no rate-limit hit -- brand-new entity) added the existing 'Purchasers 30D' audience (id 120249907176770159) as an excluded audience via ads_update_entity. The call succeeded (targeting updated exactly as intended, every other field preserved) but, same as the prior A-008 precedent (2026-08-31), the API response carried status_forced_to_paused:true / status:PAUSED as a side effect of editing targeting on a live-delivering ad set. Since this is the campaign's only ad set, Mori_Sales_0609 -- live for well under a day and the account's only active campaign -- is no longer delivering as a direct (if legitimate and correctly-scoped) consequence of this auto-tier safety fix. Flagged here per the same reasoning as A-008's log entry: this changes what's currently live, exactly the kind of consequence the approval tier exists to gate, even though the underlying edit was itself in-scope and correct. A human should decide whether to reactivate Mori_Sales_0609 now that it correctly excludes past purchasers (reactivation itself is out of this run's permitted action list -- only ads_activate_entity via an approval-tier reactivate-winner/resume proposal, or manual action in Ads Manager, can bring it back). UPDATE (2026-09-06 ~06:52 UTC pass): the account activity log shows Saif Naqvi manually reactivated the Kabuto_CAPS ad set (120255648636990159) at 2026-09-06T10:43 IST (~05:13 UTC), roughly 23 minutes after this routine's force-pause, via the Ads Manager App for iOS -- Mori_Sales_0609 is live again and delivering (3 'Started delivery' events logged 10:55-11:04 IST). Live re-fetch this pass confirms the excluded_custom_audiences targeting fix (Purchasers 30D, id 120249907176770159) this alert flagged is still correctly in place on the ad set -- the human's reactivation did not undo it. The human decision this alert asked for has been made; resolving.
